title: summary
intro:
Summary reports for log parameterizations.
  < component (title title ) >

    title: string (see section 4.1.5)
     Optional parameter
     Title of this summary. By default, use the name of the parameterization.

attrs.name: title
attrs.doc: Title of this summary. By default, use the name of the parameterization.

sections.name: Rsqr
sections.desc: Calculate coefficient of determination.
sections.sig:
< Rsqr (measure measure ...)
             (print data false)
             ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 86.
             (title title ) >

attrs.name: measure
attrs.doc:
Measured data.
       < (time time )
           (data data ...) >

attrs.name: – time
attrs.doc:
Optional submodel
         Time of measurement. Measured data will be compared to the first
         simulated value ator after this time. By default, compare with the first
         available simulated data.

attrs.name: – data
attrs.doc:
Data measured at this time.
           < tag value ... >
            * tag: string (see section 4.1.5)
              Parameter
              Name of simulated data to compare with.
            * value: number (dimension not specified) sequence
              Parameter
              Measured data.

attrs.name: print data
attrs.doc: Print a table with all data in the summary.

sections.name: balance
sections.desc: A summary model providing a balance for a log parameterization.
sections.sig:
< balance (content content ...)
               (where where )
               (precision 2)
               (input input ...)
               (output output ...)
               (require top false)
               ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 86.
               (title title ) >

attrs.name: content
attrs.doc: Tags of columns in log file representing content.

attrs.name: where
attrs.doc:
File name to store the summary. By default, the summary will be stored in
     daisy.log and the screen.

attrs.name: precision
attrs.doc: Number of digits to print after decimal point.

attrs.name: input
attrs.doc: Tags of columns in log file representing inputs.

attrs.name: output
attrs.doc: Tags of columns in log file representing outputs.

attrs.name: require top
attrs.doc:
If the balance only hold true when logging the top of the soil, i.e. the ‘from’
     parameter of the log model is 0, this flag should be set.

sections.text:
A summary model providing a balance for a log parameterization.
   Used by log Field chemical summary (see 52.13, page 295) .
  < balance (content content ...)
               (where where )
               (precision 2)
               (input input ...)
               (output output ...)
               (require top false)
               ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 86.
               (title title ) >

       content: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
        Parameter
        Tags of columns in log file representing content.

       where: string (see section 4.1.5)
        Optional parameter

     File name to store the summary. By default, the summary will be stored in
     daisy.log and the screen.

    precision: integer
     Parameter (default 2)
     Number of digits to print after decimal point.

    input: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
     Parameter
     Tags of columns in log file representing inputs.

    output: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
     Parameter
     Tags of columns in log file representing outputs.

    require top: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter (default false)
     If the balance only hold true when logging the top of the soil, i.e. the ‘from’
     parameter of the log model is 0, this flag should be set.

attrs.name: fractiles
attrs.doc: List of fractiles to summarize.

attrs.name: tags
attrs.doc: List of tags to summarize.

attrs.name: first
attrs.doc: If set, put this in the first column of the summary.

sections.text:
Show fractiles for specified tags.
  < fractiles (fractiles fractiles ...)
                    (tags tags ...)
                    (first first )
                    ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 86.
                    (title title ) >

    fractiles: number [<fraction>] sequence
     Parameter
     List of fractiles to summarize.

    tags: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
     Parameter
     List of tags to summarize.

    first: string (see section 4.1.5)
     Optional parameter
     If set, put this in the first column of the summary.

sections.name: simple
sections.desc: A simple log file summary model.
sections.sig:
< simple         (fetch fetch ...)
                   (where where )
                   (precision 2)
                   (period period )
                   (print sum true)
                   (sum name Sum)
                   ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 86.
                   (title title ) >

attrs.name: fetch
attrs.doc: List of columns to fetch for the summary.

attrs.name: where
attrs.doc:
File name to store the summary. By default, the summary will be stored in
        daisy.log and the screen.

attrs.name: precision
attrs.doc: Number of digits to print after decimal point.

attrs.name: period
attrs.doc:
Set this to ’y’, ’m’, ’w’, ’d’ or ’h’ to get fluxes per time period instead of total
        amount.

attrs.name: print sum
attrs.doc: Print sum of all the summary lines.

attrs.name: sum name
attrs.doc: Name of the sum of all the entries.

sections.text:
A simple log file summary model.

  < simple         (fetch fetch ...)
                   (where where )
                   (precision 2)
                   (period period )
                   (print sum true)
                   (sum name Sum)
                   ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 86.
                   (title title ) >

       fetch: FetchPretty fixed component (see section 107.14) sequence
        List of columns to fetch for the summary.

       where: string (see section 4.1.5)
        Optional parameter
        File name to store the summary. By default, the summary will be stored in
        daisy.log and the screen.
       precision: integer
        Parameter (default 2)
        Number of digits to print after decimal point.
       period : string (see section 4.1.5)
        Optional parameter
        Set this to ’y’, ’m’, ’w’, ’d’ or ’h’ to get fluxes per time period instead of total
        amount.
       print sum: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
        Parameter (default true)
        Print sum of all the summary lines.
       sum name: string (see section 4.1.5)
        Parameter (default ‘Sum’)
        Name of the sum of all the entries.
